title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30428: add sales order line update event
summary: A new event OnBeforeUpdateSalesOrderLineIfExist allows extensions to intercept and override the default sales order line update logic during sales return order posting, enabling custom handling of prepayment amounts.
key_points: New OnBeforeUpdateSalesOrderLineIfExist event added to Sales-Post codeunit
Event includes an initialized IsHandled parameter for overriding standard behavior
Enables extensions to prevent automatic prepayment amount restoration to open orders
Added across all localization layers (W1, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, GB, IT, NA, NO, RU)
Allows subscribers to implement custom update logic that fits their business requirements
quote: Extensions need to bypass the standard sales order line update when posting sales return orders
